thread: Marco S: quick design check — I'm iterating on the variant preview micro-interaction for the model catalog. when you hover a model row we show a compact preview panel with perf badges + version selector. want to align on keyboard + screen reader behavior. screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/variant-preview.png Katy L: looks promising. two things stood out: 1) keyboard focus into the preview is not discoverable, 2) perf badges feel visually heavy when there are 3+ metrics. can we de-emphasize secondary badges? :thinking_face: Jamal: agree on badge density. proposal: show a primary metric (latency) and collapse others under a chevron/expand. clicking the panel should persist it. also call out mobile narrow-width behavior 12px+? Ava (a11y): accessibility notes: do not trap focus for hover-only transient previews. for pointer hover use aria-live for announcements. if user explicitly opens preview (keyboard or click) then shift focus into a tabbable panel. add an accessible name: `aria-label=\"Variant preview for \"`. :a11y: Marco S: current prototype moves focus to the version selector on click which felt okay, but I'll change hover to an aria-live announce. example snip:```html Preview opened: resnet-v2-atom1 12ms latency, 420 t/s ``` Katy L: for keyboard users we still need a clear focus target. suggestion: make the preview reachable via Tab from the row and show a subtle focus ring on the panel. pointer users keep hover/announce; keyboard users get explicit focus. Jamal: engineering constraints: avoid layout reflow on focus. prefer absolute/overlay positioning and use transform for show/hide animations. debounce aria-live updates (500ms) so SRs don't read a stream when mousing across rows. Ava (a11y): also ensure each perf badge has a verbose label for SRs, e.g., `aria-label=\"Typical latency: 84 milliseconds\"` not just `latency`. test for duplicate announcements when expanding/collapsing. Priya: from product: customers want fast compare flows. can the preview include a compact \"Add to compare\" control (a small checkbox) that maps to the compare table? keeps row uncluttered and supports quick selection. Marco S: plan: compact preview on hover (aria-live announce) + tabbable overlay when opened (enter/tab) with small `Add to compare` checkbox. primary badge visible; secondary badges collapsed behind chevron. accessibility: aria-live with 500ms debounce, explicit aria-labels for badges, and keyboard Esc closes and returns focus to the row. Katy L: copy nit: change badge tooltip from `p50 latency` to `Typical latency (p50)` and use sentence case for the preview header. small but important for consistency. Jamal: implementation checklist: 1) overlay positioning w/ transform animations 2) tabbable panel (no trap unless persistent open) 3) aria-live region + 500ms debounce 4) data-model-id on elements for analytics hooks. will prototype and send PR. Ava (a11y): test plan I'll run: NVDA/VoiceOver hover announce, keyboard open and close, add-to-compare flow via keyboard, badge labelling verification, and rapid-tab dedupe checks. DevBot: deploy-preview created for branch `feat/catalog/preview-a11y` — preview: https://staging.redwood/feat-catalog-preview (build #472). :rocket: Priya: decision: prioritize keyboard & accessibility fixes in the next patch; badge density refinements in following sprint. update release notes and catalog docs accordingly. Marco S: thanks all. I'll update Figma, push accessibility tweaks to the branch, and ping when the build is ready for QA. action items: - Marco: update prototype & Figma (due EOD) - Jamal: prototype overlay + debounce logic (PR by Wed) - Ava: author a11y test checklist (start after PR) - Katy: microcopy updates & badge priority list Katy L: final micro-ux ask 12When preview is opened via keyboard, Esc should close and return focus to the originating row. documented. :white_check_mark:
